create_mock_requester: create a MockRequester instance by calling MockRequester.new with a MephistoDB and requester name
register_mock_requester: register a MockRequester by calling register with optional DictConfig args to force failure
check_mock_requester_registered: check if a MockRequester is registered by calling is_registered on the instance
get_mock_budget: get the available mock budget of 100000.0 by calling get_available_budget on a MockRequester
check_mock_sandbox: check if MockRequester is sandbox mode by calling the is_sandbox class method
